triples.description: The knowledge graph: known facts as [head, relation, tail] lists of names, e.g. ["Paris", "capital_of", "France"]. Names are any strings (or numbers); the same name is the same entity or relation everywhere. Every fact is also read backwards (tail, inverse relation, head). At most 1,000,000 triples.

relation.description: The query relation; it must appear in triples.

head.description: Find missing tails of (head, relation, ?). Give head or tail, not both.

tail.description: Find missing heads of (?, relation, tail). Give head or tail, not both.

top_k.description: How many ranked entities to return.

exclude_known.description: Leave out answers already stated in triples, so the list holds only missing links (the standard filtered ranking).
